releases.notes:
## [1.0.0]

First release — a client-side dungeon map for Hypixel SkyBlock Catacombs, a modern Fabric remake of
UnclaimedBloom6's IllegalMap.

### Platform
- Minecraft 26.1.2 (Fabric 0.149.1+26.1.2, Loader 0.19.2), Java 21.
- Requires PlayerAPI 1.19.0+ (Mojang-mapped; uses the shared `UpdateChecker`, `TabListInfo` indexed tab
  access, `ScoreboardInfo`, `BoxActions`, `LineActions`, and the shared HUD editor).

### Added

**Dungeon map**
- Live map of the Catacombs dungeon rendered as a movable/scalable HUD element (shared HUD editor).
- Room names, secret counts, and cleared/failed **checkmarks** read from the vanilla dungeon map item
  (checkmark replaces the name once a room is cleared).
- Rooms identified from their block layout via a **modern block fingerprint** (future-forward) with the
  original 1.8.9 **legacy cores** as a fallback; learned fingerprints persist across sessions.

**Dungeon score**
- Live score panel — a faithful port of Hypixel's real Catacombs formula (Skill / Explore / Speed /
  Bonus), with an optional **line-by-line breakdown**.
- Score computes live through the whole run **including the boss** (going over time or dying in the boss
  still lowers it); the clock stops at the run's end.
- Timer starts on Mort's intro line (matching Hypixel) and recovers from the sidebar on a reconnect;
  optional **millisecond-precision** display for speedrunners.
- **270 / 300 milestone** alerts and a **secrets-done** alert (when secrets reach full-score), each with
  optional on-screen title and optional party-chat announce. Mayor Paul (+10) toggle.

**ESP & detection**
- **Star-mob ESP** (through-wall boxes) + **radar** (dots on the map) + line to the nearest star mob.
- **Wither / blood-door ESP** — through-wall boxes on the next doors along the route to Blood.
- **Mimic detection** (F6+) — tints the Mimic's room, optionally highlights its chest through walls, and
  alerts on the kill (+2 score).
- **Party-player markers** — teammates shown on the map (skin-face heads) even out of render distance,
  named from the tab party list.

**Community mapping**
- When you enter a room Hades has never seen, a clickable prompt opens a GUI to **identify** it (from
  same-shape database candidates) or **submit** it to the repo (pre-filled GitHub issue, room block data
  only — no personal info). Submitted rooms can earn a README shout-out.
- The room database **auto-updates** from the repo once per launch (ETag-conditional), so new room data
  ships without a mod release. A player's locally-mapped rooms survive updates and can be cleared from
  the config screen.

**Other**
- YACL config screen (ModMenu-integrated) for all options; the map + score HUD are placed via the shared
  HUD editor.
- Optional `/joininstance` shortcuts (off by default): `/ce`, `/c1`–`/c7`, `/m1`–`/m7`, `/k1`–`/k5`.
- In-game update checker (PlayerAPI shared `UpdateChecker`) on world join.

### Credits
- Original **IllegalMap** design by [UnclaimedBloom6](https://github.com/UnclaimedBloom6). Hades is an
  independent remake and is not affiliated with the original author.
